_note: Six families over the 23 practice categories, for the homepage. Twenty-three boxes is a filing cabinet; six is a menu. Each family is named for what a visitor DOES there — the same want-axis language as goodfor.json — while the categories underneath keep their real names and URLs, so nothing about the taxonomy, the counts or the SEO changes. Every category must appear exactly once: a category missing from this file is dropped from the homepage, which is why load() checks. Ordered as a journey rather than by size: move, restore, mind, nourish, connect, escape. Each family also names a want from goodfor.json; the card takes its colour from there, so the homepage, the chips and the card tags stay one palette.
